title: US-short §8 削减叠法 (position sizing reduction stack) governance — const-pins the ordered 5-step pipeline + the take-harshest-not-compound risk-discount rule + the min() cap set + the below-min→observe floor
description: Batch-1 declarative governance contract. Freezes the §8 削减叠法 sizing pipeline so a future batch-2 sizing engine cannot reorder the steps, compound risk discounts, drop a cap from the min(), or skip the below-minimum→observe floor. Pins: the 5-step order (base shares → × environment multiplier [market_risk_regime] → × risk discount → min(caps) → below-min→observe); the risk-discount factor set (数据降级/主题拥挤/集群超集中/财报前) with the SAFETY rule take-harshest-single + NO compounding (取最狠的一个、不连乘); the min() cap set (单票上限/剩余总仓/剩余主题容量/流动性上限/可用现金/全局现金分配额); and below_min_executable→observe. Cap VALUES (单票 10% / 总仓 60% / 同主题 30% / 单笔风险 0.75% etc.) are forward priors routed to §13.1 #4, not pinned. draft-07 cannot express: byte-faithfulness of factors/caps to §8, provenance of each mechanic, and cap_value_calibration_item_id ∈ the lifecycle registry — enforced in tests.

sizing_pipeline.description: §8 削减叠法 ①-⑤ ordered steps; ORDER is design-locked (a must-stop floor at the end).

risk_discount_factors.description: §8 step ③ risk-discount factor set, byte-faithful (取最狠的一个、不连乘 applies across these).

risk_discount_policy.description: §8 step ③ SAFETY rule — take the single harshest discount, never compound them.

min_caps.description: §8 step ④ min() cap set, byte-faithful — the sized shares must be ≤ the minimum of all of these.

below_min_executable_to_observe.description: §8 step ⑤ — below minimum executable size ⟹ downgrade to observe (no sub-minimum order).

environment_multiplier_source.description: §8 step ② environment multiplier source = market_risk_regime (us_short_regime_governance caps).

cap_value_calibration_item_id.description: §8 cap VALUES (单笔/单票/总仓/同主题/环境乘数 + 财报前窗口) = prior → §13.1 #4.
